column3: BSB renders “being in the body” as “suffering with them.”
BSB renders “manner of life” as “lives” and supplies “God.”
BSB renders “His reproach” as “the disgrace He bore.”
BSB renders “to conduct ourselves well” as “to live honorably.”
BSB follows the critical text with “every good thing” and “in us”; the Textus Receptus reads “every good work” and “in you.”
BSB follows the critical text with “our brother” and adds “I will come with him.”
BSB follows the critical text without “Amen”; the Textus Receptus also adds a closing note about writing from Italy through Timothy.
